name: Uarzazat
hero_subtitle: Kasbas, escenarios de cine y la puerta entre el Alto Atlas y las rutas del desierto.

info.vibe_val: Desert edge, kasbahs and film Morocco
info.airport_val: OZZ Ouarzazate · Road from Marrakech (~4–5 h)

overview.title: Welcome to Ouarzazate — Gateway to the Desert
overview.p1: Ouarzazate sits where the High Atlas opens onto the pre-Saharan plateaus. Kasbah Taourirt anchors the town; Atlas Studios and Aït Benhaddou explain its place in cinema and heritage.
overview.p2: Two or three days cover the town kasbah, the studios and Aït Benhaddou, with time for Fint Oasis or Tifoultoute.

places.title: Places to visit in Ouarzazate
places.subtitle: Kasbahs, studios, a UNESCO ksar and oases.

taourirt.name: Kasbah Taourirt
taourirt.desc: Former Glaoui stronghold and desert-gateway atmosphere.

ait-benhaddou.name: Aït Benhaddou
ait-benhaddou.desc: Famous earthen ksar on the old caravan route.

tifoultoute.name: Kasbah Tifoultoute
tifoultoute.desc: Hillside kasbah with wide views and quieter feel.

cinema-museum.name: Cinema Museum
cinema-museum.desc: Costumes and the story of filming in Ouarzazate.

skoura.name: Skoura Oasis
skoura.desc: Wide palm oasis and kasbahs toward Dadès.

itinerary.title: 3 días en Uarzazat
itinerary.subtitle: Town and studios, then Aït Benhaddou, then an oasis or the road east.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Pasea por los patios y terrazas de la antigua kasba de los Glaoui al borde de la ciudad.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Camina entre los escenarios al aire libre que convirtieron Uarzazat en un centro de cine.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Cena sencilla en el centro; acuéstate temprano si mañana es Ait Ben Haddou.
detailed_itinerary.day2_m: Mañana — Camino a Ait Ben Haddou
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Sal temprano hacia el ksar UNESCO; sube para el panorama clásico.
detailed_itinerary.day2_a: Tarde — Callejones del ksar y almuerzo
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Explora el pueblo fortificado y almuerza en la orilla moderna.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Vuelta a la ciudad; Museo del Cine opcional.
detailed_itinerary.day3_m: Mañana — Oasis de Fint o Tifoultoute
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Senderos de palmeras y pistas de pueblo, o una kasba más tranquila en la colina.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Oasis hacia el Dadés, o compras y descanso en la ciudad.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Hacia el Dadés o el Draa/Zagora, o regreso a Marrakech según tu ruta.

stays.title: Where to stay in Ouarzazate? Our favourites
stays.subtitle: Palace comfort in town, boutique riads and a quiet lodge among the palms toward Skoura.

card1.name: Le Berbère Palace
card1.desc: Reference palace hotel with pools, gardens and elegant service — the classic upscale base in Ouarzazate.

card2.name: Dar Chamaa
card2.desc: Elegant boutique house with earthen character, quiet courtyard and refined rooms near the centre.

card3.name: Riad Dar Sofian
card3.desc: Traditional riad comfort, warm décor, terrace and a quiet base for kasbahs and studios.

card4.name: Les Jardins de Skoura
card4.desc: Quiet lodge among palm gardens to the east — ideal for peaceful nights and the Dadès road.

eat.title: Where to eat in Ouarzazate
eat.subtitle: Family tajines in town, Aït Benhaddou terraces and simple local tables — no nightlife.

nomad.title: Restaurant Douiria
nomad.desc: Traditional Moroccan restaurant near the kasbah — tajines, couscous and local family atmosphere.

jardin.title: La Datte d’Or
jardin.desc: Well-reviewed address in town — tajines, kefta and generous portions for families.

fassia.title: Aït Benhaddou Terraces
fassia.desc: Lunch on a terrace facing the ksar — tajines with UNESCO view, best at midday.

moha.title: Restaurant Todgha
moha.desc: Local favourite for home-style Moroccan dishes, tajines and friendly service at fair prices.

bacha.title: Café Restaurant Sabrina
bacha.desc: Café-restaurant for Moroccan meals and tea — practical after the kasbah or a long road.

elfenn.title: Skoura Guesthouse Table
elfenn.desc: Fixed menus in palm-grove guesthouses — quiet dinner on the Dadès road.

transport.title: Getting around
transport.desc: Petit taxis in town; private drivers for Aït Benhaddou, Skoura and Fint.

bargain.title: Sun & altitude
bargain.desc: Strong sun and dry air. Nights can be cool.

water.title: Day trips
water.desc: Aït Benhaddou is essential. Skoura, Dadès and Draa need more time.

daytrips.title: Trips from Ouarzazate
daytrips.subtitle: UNESCO ksar, oases and eastern gorges.

dades.name: Dadès Gorge
dades.desc: Road of kasbahs east of Skoura.

q1.question: How many days in Ouarzazate?
q1.answer: Two days for Taourirt, the studios and Aït Benhaddou. A third for Fint, Skoura or the start of the desert.

q2.question: Is Ouarzazate only a stopover?
q2.answer: A logistics hub, but the kasbah, studios and Aït Benhaddou justify one or two nights.

q3.question: How do I get there?
q3.answer: OZZ airport has limited flights. Most arrive by road from Marrakech (4–5 hours).

q4.question: Best time?
q4.answer: Spring and autumn. Summer is very hot; winter is cold at night.
